prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Gates Enterprises** looks like a strong first call based on the available results: it reports **348+ Google reviews and a 4.9-star rating** and specializes in Denver hail damage. [Gates Enterprises](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver)

I’d also get a comparison quote from **Red Diamond Roofing** or **Trek Contracting**; both advertise storm-damage expertise and industry credentials. [Red Diamond](https://reddiamondroof.com/services/storm-damage-repair/) · [Trek Contracting](https://www.trekcontracting.com/roofing/repair/)

Before signing, verify the contractor’s Colorado/local licensing and insurance, ask for recent local references, and get a written scope and warranty. Be cautious of anyone pressuring you to sign immediately or promising to “cover” your insurance deductible.
